mapper.insert: insert into ai_after_sales_outbox ( event_id, application_id, member_id, application_source, event_type, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{eventId}, #{applicationId}, #{memberId}, #{applicationSource}, #{eventType}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{availableAt}, #{leaseUntil}, #{publishedAt}, #{lastError}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, event_id, application_id, member_id, application_source, event_type, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, create_time, update_time from ai_after_sales_outbox where (status = 'PENDING' and (available_at is null or available_at <= now())) or (status = 'PUBLISHING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= now()) order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_after_sales_outbox set status = 'PUBLISHING', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, lease_until = date_add(now(), interval #{leaseSeconds} second), update_time = now() where id = #{id} and ( (status = 'PENDING' and (available_at is null or available_at <= now())) or (status = 'PUBLISHING' and lease_until is not null and lease_until <= now()) )
update ai_after_sales_outbox set status = 'PUBLISHED', lease_until = null, published_at = now(), last_error = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING'

update ai_after_sales_outbox set status = #{status},
available_at = null,
available_at = date_add(now(), interval #{retryDelaySeconds} second),
lease_until = null, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PUBLISHING'
